content.comment_body: Hello, I requested the DAMEX check so I could update [product_name] from [version_no] to [version_no]. I received an email saying my request was denied because I didn't have a company or school name in the required field. I'm a private user and have been using [product_name] for a while but don't have a company name. Any suggestions for what I should enter?
Unfortunately, 'Private User' did not work. I received another denial, so I still can't upgrade. Do you have any other ideas?
Use 'Private use', not 'Private User'. I don't have another suggestion. Could you share the exact wording from the email? Perhaps the moderator could assist you.

Is anyone else having trouble getting the DAMEX key? I am a private user without a company and keep getting denied because of the missing company name. I tried 'Private Use', but it still gets rejected.
Please provide the rejection email. I find it hard to believe they'd only reject you for entering 'private use'.

Hi [user_name], I contacted the responsible person about your issue and they confirmed your registration was checked again and approved this morning. You should have received a confirmation email. If you have further questions or run into issues, please let us know. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator
Thank you [user_name]_Moderator. I received the confirmation email today. I appreciate your assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered issues upgrading [product_name] from [version_no] to [version_no] because the DAMEX license request process required a company or school name, which was not applicable to private users. This caused confusion and made it difficult for individuals to obtain necessary updates.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates being able to register and obtain a DAMEX key for [product_name] as a private individual, without needing affiliation with a company or school, and to upgrade the software without administrative obstacles.
